constructions.title: Figures read from the pinned texts of regulations and a report

bek931.ceiling_kg_n_ha.is: The manure ceiling in BEK 931/2024: the organic nitrogen a holding has for spreading, divided by this many kg N per hectare, may not exceed its harmoniareal.

bek931.derogation_kg_n_ha.is: The rate BEK 931/2024 names for holdings that had been granted permission to spread more organic nitrogen per hectare of harmoniareal - the cattle derogation.

bek673.catch_crop_pct.is: The compulsory catch-crop area in BEK 673/2026, as a percentage of the holding's catch-crop base area.

bek673.catch_crop_pct_high.is: The same, for a holding spreading organic nitrogen at or above `threshold_high_kg_n_ha` per hectare of harmoniareal.

bek673.threshold_low_kg_n_ha.is: The organic-nitrogen application, kg N per hectare of harmoniareal, from which the livestock catch-crop requirement applies.

bek673.threshold_high_kg_n_ha.is: The organic-nitrogen application, kg N per hectare of harmoniareal, at which the higher compulsory percentage and the higher quota-cut rate apply.

bek673.quota_cut_below_kg_n_ha.is: The cut in the holding's own nitrogen quota, kg N per hectare of catch crop not established, for a holding below `threshold_high_kg_n_ha`.

bek673.quota_cut_above_kg_n_ha.is: The same cut, for a holding at or above `threshold_high_kg_n_ha`.

bek677.min_base_ha.is: The catch-crop base area, in hectares, below which BEK 677/2026 does not apply to a holding.

bek677.annex1.rows.*.pct.is: The targeted catch-crop requirement for one coastal catchment in BEK 677/2026 Bilag 1, as a percentage of the base area a holding has in that catchment.

bek677.annex1.n_catchments.is: The coastal catchments listed in BEK 677/2026 Bilag 1, as parsed: every catchment that carries a targeted requirement.

bek677.annex1.n_at_ceiling.is: Of those, the catchments whose percentage equals the largest in the table.

bek130.priority_rotation_kr_ha.is: The one-off payment per hectare in BEK 130/2026 for permanent extensification of land that was in rotation (crop codes of its Bilag 1), where at least half the field is carbon-rich or in an area of large nitrogen need with wetland potential.

bek130.priority_grass_kr_ha.is: The same, for land in the crop codes of its Bilag 2 (grass), in the same priority areas.

bek130.elsewhere_rotation_kr_ha.is: The payment for rotation land outside those areas.

bek130.elsewhere_grass_kr_ha.is: The payment for grass outside those areas.

nuar_t75.rows.*.*.is: One cell of NUAR Tabel 7.5: the change in gross margin (DB2, kroner per hectare) against the reference regulation, for one enterprise type in the Hjarbæk Fjord catchment, under one quota-allocation model; the last three models are the report's trading variants.

constructions.what: Reads each figure INCIDENCE.md takes from a regulation or from the NUAR report out of that document's pinned text.
constructions.model: Every single figure is matched by a regular expression built from the document's own wording around it, against the whitespace-normalised pinned text, and must match exactly once; Danish number format is converted (`10,7` is ten point seven, `1.122` has a thousands separator). BEK 677/2026 Bilag 1 is parsed as its three columns in order - catchment numbers, names, percentages - and NUAR Tabel 7.5 as its cells in reading order.
assumptions: The extracted text preserves each document's wording and the order of its table cells.
The wording chosen around each figure identifies the provision the page describes.

justified.text: Each document is pinned by the sha256 of its extracted text; a change in the live document is detected by a recheck and refuses the pin until it is read again.
A figure whose wording occurs other than exactly once refuses the run, so no figure can be read from the wrong provision silently.

The parsed tables were compared with the transcriptions that were previously typed into the page's generator, and agree in every cell of Bilag 1 and in every model column of Tabel 7.5; so were the four extensification rates.

gaps: The last two rows of NUAR Tabel 7.5 come out of the extraction interleaved, column by column; the parser splits them on that layout, which a different extraction could change without any wording check noticing.
That each provision means what the page says it means is a reading, not something the pattern checks.
The expiry of the cattle derogation is not stated in BEK 931/2024 and is not read from any pinned document.
void_if: a document is amended and re-pinned without this script being rerun
the extraction tool changes how it orders table cells
constructions.licenses: What the regulations and the NUAR report state, as figures, and nothing typed in between.
constructions.not_licensed: That the provisions have the effects the page argues, or that the one NUAR catchment tabulated is representative of the others.

constructions.title: Who carries the nitrogen requirement: herds, land and filed accounts, joined on CVR

total_de.is: Register animal units (`DE`) summed over every business with a CVR number in the livestock register, the herd every share of the herd is taken of.

visibility.n_animal_cvr.is: Businesses in the livestock register with a CVR number, whatever their herd.

visibility.by_form.*.n.is: Of those, the businesses of one legal form as the CVR extract records it; those missing from the extract form their own group.

visibility.by_form.*.de.is: Register animal units summed over the businesses of one legal form.

visibility.by_accounts.*.n.is: Businesses keeping animals whose CVR record does, or does not, list published accounts - the flag K-INCIDENCE describes.

visibility.by_accounts.*.de.is: Register animal units summed over the businesses on one side of that flag.

visibility.n_with_herd.is: Businesses whose register animal units are above zero.

visibility.median_de.is: The median herd, in animal units, over the businesses in `n_with_herd`; a positional median.

visibility.p90_de.is: The ninetieth percentile of the same herds, by position.

visibility.p99_de.is: The ninety-ninth percentile of the same herds, by position.

visibility.concentration.*.level.is: The share of the national herd a concentration row is about, as a fraction; chosen to span the distribution.

visibility.concentration.*.holdings.is: How many of the largest herds, taken largest first, it takes to hold that share of the herd.

visibility.concentration.*.pct_of_holdin.is: Those holdings as a percentage of `n_with_herd`.

types.*.n.is: Businesses with animal units above zero, of one enterprise type as `enterprise_type` classifies them from the register's species and production codes.

types.*.de.is: Register animal units summed over the businesses of one enterprise type.

types.*.share_de.is: Those animal units as a percentage of `total_de`.

types.*.n_ratio.is: Of the businesses of that type, those declaring more than one hectare of field parcels: the only ones with a stocking density.

types.*.med.is: The median stocking density - animal units over declared hectares - over the businesses in `n_ratio`, by position.

types.*.p90.is: The ninetieth percentile of the same densities, by position.

types.*.over.*.is: Of the businesses in `n_ratio`, the percentage whose stocking density is above the line named by the key, in animal units per declared hectare.

types.*.surplus.is: Animal units above what the business's own declared hectares would carry at `surplus_line_de_ha`, summed over the businesses of that type that have such a surplus.

types.*.n_surplus.is: The businesses of that type with a surplus above `surplus_line_de_ha`.

types.*.landless_de.is: Register animal units on businesses of that type declaring no more than one hectare.

types.*.n_landless.is: The businesses of that type declaring no more than one hectare.

regions.*.n.is: Businesses with animals placed in one region: each is placed at the kommune holding most of its animal units, and the kommune at its region.

regions.*.de.is: Register animal units summed over the businesses placed in that region.

regions.*.n_ratio.is: Of those, the businesses declaring more than one hectare.

regions.*.med.is: The median stocking density over the businesses in `n_ratio`, by position.

regions.*.over14.is: Of the businesses in `n_ratio`, the percentage above the historic harmony density, `historic_limits_de_ha` first entry.

kommuner.*.n_ratio.is: Businesses declaring more than one hectare placed in one kommune, by the same placement rule as the regions.

kommuner.*.med.is: Their median stocking density, by position.

kommuner.*.over14.is: The percentage of them above the historic harmony density.

kommuner.*.de.is: Register animal units summed over the businesses placed in that kommune.

organic.*.n.is: Cattle businesses - cattle at least `0.7` of their animal units - in one cohort: dairy where dairy-cattle animal units exceed half the herd, else beef and other cattle; organic where the register's organic share exceeds one half.

organic.*.de.is: Register animal units summed over one such cohort.

organic.*.mean_de.is: Those animal units divided by the cohort's businesses.

organic.*.n_ratio.is: Of the cohort, the businesses declaring more than one hectare.

organic.*.med.is: Their median stocking density, by position.

organic.*.over14.is: The percentage of them above the historic harmony density.

hectares.n_cvr.is: Businesses with declared field parcels in the sibling's hectares-per-CVR table.

hectares.by_type.*.n.is: Land-declaring businesses of one enterprise type; a business with no animal units forms the group `no animal units`.

hectares.by_type.*.ha.is: Declared hectares summed over the land-declaring businesses of one enterprise type.

hectares.base.*.*.is: Declared hectares of one enterprise type, split by whether each business's single largest declared crop is inside the catch-crop base area, outside it, or unclassified by `crop_base`.

hectares.by_accounts.*.n.is: Land-declaring businesses on one side of the published-accounts flag.

hectares.by_accounts.*.ha.is: Declared hectares summed over the businesses on one side of that flag.

hectares.top_crops.*.*.is: Declared hectares summed by each business's single largest declared crop - hectare-weighted, so the whole of a business's land counts under its largest crop.

hectares.median_ha.is: The median declared area per land-declaring business, by position.

hectares.p99_ha.is: The ninety-ninth percentile of the same areas, by position.

hectares.cvrs_holding_half_the_land.is: How many of the largest land declarations, taken largest first, it takes to reach half the declared hectares.

accounts_sample.n_primary_agriculture.is: Businesses in `n_filed` whose industry code starts with a primary-agriculture prefix in `FARM_NACE`, that have a filing spanning roughly a year and a usable balance sheet.

accounts_sample.n_keeping_animals.is: Of those, the businesses with animal units above zero and a herd-derived enterprise type.

accounts_sample.n_with_land.is: Of those, the businesses declaring more than one hectare.

accounts_sample.excluded.*.is: Filings dropped from the sample, by the reason named by the key.

accounts_sample.equity_deciles.*.is: The deciles of the equity ratio - equity over total assets - over the primary-agriculture filings, each by position.

accounts_sample.balance_sheet_check.*.n.is: Filings in the balance-sheet identity check, split by whether the long-term debt tag is present.

accounts_sample.balance_sheet_check.*.me.is: The median of assets minus equity minus the debts filed, as a fraction of assets: how well the identity closes.

cohorts.*.n.is: Filings in the animal-keeping sample of one enterprise type.

cohorts.*.median_de.is: Their median herd in animal units, by position.

cohorts.*.median_assets.is: Their median total assets, in kroner, by position.

cohorts.*.median_equity_ratio.is: Their median equity ratio, by position.

cohorts.*.pct_negative_equity.is: The percentage of them with equity below zero.

cohorts.*.pct_loss.is: Of those carrying a profit figure, the percentage whose last filed twelve-month profit is below zero.

cohorts.*.median_profit_per_ha.is: The median of last filed profit per declared hectare, over those declaring more than one hectare, by position.

cohorts.*.median_density.is: Their median stocking density, by position.

cohorts.*.median_biological_share.is: The median of biological assets over total assets, where the tag is filed, by position.

cohorts.*.n_profit_3y.is: Those with three twelve-month filings all carrying profit.

cohorts.*.median_profit_3y.is: The median of profit summed over those three filings, by position.

cohorts.*.pct_profit_3y_negative.is: The percentage whose three-year profit is below zero.

cohorts.*.median_equity_trajectory.is: The median change in equity ratio from the first of those filings to the last, by position.

cohorts.*.pct_trajectory_falling.is: The percentage whose equity ratio fell over the same filings.

shock.*.n.is: Filings of one enterprise type with a profit figure and more than one declared hectare - the per-hectare ladder's cohort.

shock.*.break_even_median.is: The median of last filed profit per declared hectare over that cohort: the charge per hectare the median holding could absorb exactly.

shock.*.ladder.*.is: The percentage of that cohort whose last filed profit, minus the charge named by the key times its declared hectares, is below zero.

shock_de.*.n.is: Filings of one enterprise type with a profit figure and animal units above zero - the per-animal-unit ladder's cohort, landless holdings included.

shock_de.*.n_landless.is: Of those, the holdings declaring no more than one hectare.

shock_de.*.break_even_median.is: The median of last filed profit per animal unit over that cohort.

shock_de.*.ladder.*.is: The percentage whose last filed profit, minus the charge named by the key times its animal units, is below zero.

shock_de.*.n_with_land.is: The cohort's holdings declaring more than one hectare.

shock_de.*.pct_loss_landless.is: The percentage of the landless holdings whose last filed profit is below zero.

shock_de.*.pct_loss_with_land.is: The percentage of the holdings with land whose last filed profit is below zero.

intersection.line.is: The stocking density, in animal units per declared hectare, at or above which a holding counts as exposed: the higher regulatory threshold located by the stated conversion.

intersection.by_type.*.*.is: Filings of one enterprise type in one cell of exposed-or-not by thin-or-not; a landless holding counts as exposed, and thin means an equity ratio below `thin_equity_ratio`.

intersection.de_held.is: Register animal units summed over the holdings that are both exposed and thin.

intersection.median_equity_ratio.is: Their median equity ratio, by position.

intersection.n_loss.is: Of them, those whose last filed profit is below zero.

intersection.n_negative_equity.is: Of them, those with equity below zero.

intersection.n_years_of_equity.is: Of them, those with positive equity and a loss - the cohort the years-of-equity median is taken over.

debt_artefact.*.pct_lt_filed.is: The percentage of one type's filings that carry the long-term debt tag.

debt_artefact.*.naive_median.is: The median short-term share of debt when an absent long-term tag is read as zero, by position - the wrong reading, kept to show its size.

debt_artefact.*.strict_median.is: The same median over filings carrying both debt tags.

params.n_per_de_kg.is: The stated conversion, kilograms of nitrogen per animal unit, the pre-reform unit was built on; not verified here.

params.reg_thresholds_de_ha.*.is: The two regulatory thresholds located in animal units per declared hectare: the pinned kilogram thresholds over the stated conversion, which the generator checks.

params.historic_limits_de_ha.*.is: The pre-reform harmony ceilings in animal units per hectare, kept for continuity with the other pages; they have no legal force.

params.surplus_line_de_ha.is: The density above which a holding's animal units count as surplus to its own land: the first historic harmony ceiling.

params.thin_equity_ratio.is: The equity ratio below which a balance sheet counts as thin.

params.min_kommune_holdings.is: The number of land-declaring holdings a kommune needs before its median density is shown.

params.shock_ha_kr.*.is: The rungs of the per-hectare charge ladder, in kroner per declared hectare.

params.shock_de_kr.*.is: The rungs of the per-animal-unit charge ladder, in kroner per animal unit.

constructions.what: Joins the sibling project's livestock register, declared field parcels, CVR master data and parsed annual accounts on the CVR number, and aggregates them into cohorts - by enterprise type, legal form, place, organic status and filing status - with every figure a count, a sum, a share or a positional statistic over a named cohort.
constructions.model: Per business: animal units from the livestock register, declared hectares from the parcel register, legal form, industry code and accounts flag from the CVR extract, and the newest filing spanning roughly a year from the parsed accounts. Enterprise type comes from the register's species and production codes (`enterprise_type`). A business has a stocking density only if it declares more than one hectare. Cohort statistics are medians and percentiles taken by position (`q`), shares are part over whole of the same cohort (`share`), and the charge ladders subtract a charge per hectare or per animal unit from the last filed twelve-month profit.
assumptions: The CVR number on a herd, on a parcel and on a filing identifies one operating business.
Declared parcel area stands in for the area a holding can spread on, though it is neither harmoniareal nor the catch-crop base area.
The last filed twelve-month profit represents the holding's margin against which a charge would fall.
A business's single largest declared crop stands for its whole declared area when splitting land by the catch-crop base.

justified.text: Cohorts are published only with their counts, and medians are used throughout because one filing's equity ratio is extreme enough to decide a mean.
Flows are taken only from filings spanning roughly a year, and stock and flow from the same filing.
The long-term debt tag's absence is checked against the balance-sheet identity before it is read as zero, and the composition error it causes is computed and shown rather than hidden.
The per-animal-unit ladder exists because the per-hectare ladder drops every landless holding.
The surplus is measured above a line named in the code, so it cannot drift when the list of lines changes.

gaps: Until this conversion the surplus was measured above the first entry of a list whose first entry had changed, while the page said it was measured above the historic harmony ceiling; the figures before and after the fix differ.
The cut-offs that define a cattle business, a dairy cohort and an organic one (`0.7`, a half, a half in `organic_split`) are typed in the code and explained nowhere.
`enterprise_type` classifies a business from its register codes; its rules are not documented on the page.
The threshold positions rest on an unverified conversion, and declared area is not harmoniareal, so exposure locates the thresholds rather than testing them.
The filed accounts are the readable filings on the sibling's livestock map, selected by legal form: statistics over them carry selection bias, not sampling error in the usual sense.
void_if: the sibling project's registers are refetched and this script is not rerun
a holding's animals, land and accounts sit under different CVR numbers
constructions.licenses: Counts, sums, shares and positional statistics over the named cohorts of the open registers and of the businesses that file accounts.
constructions.not_licensed: Anything about a named holding, about businesses that file nothing, or about compliance with the regulations; any forecast of insolvency.

constructions.title: Every enumerated pathway of reactive nitrogen to Danish marine waters, with bounds

pathways.*.lo.is: The lower bound, kilotonnes of nitrogen a year, for one pathway of reactive nitrogen to Danish marine waters; null where the pathway has no number.

pathways.*.hi.is: The upper bound for the same pathway, on the same terms.

constructions.what: A hand-compiled register of every pathway of reactive nitrogen to Danish marine waters this project could enumerate, each with plausible bounds in kilotonnes a year, its status (measured, modelled or unquantified) and a note on where the bounds come from.
constructions.model: Bounds are read from published figures where they exist and constructed by this project where they do not; the register marks the constructed ones. Unquantified pathways carry no bounds. Sums over the pathways that have bounds give a floor on the total, because every empty row can only add.
assumptions: The enumeration catches the pathways that matter; an unlisted pathway would change every sum and share taken over the register.

justified.text: Each pathway's note names where its bounds come from, and the register says which bounds are constructed here rather than published.

gaps: The bounds are plausible ranges, not confidence intervals, and the notes do not give a pinned source for each.
Whether the enumeration is complete is not testable from inside the register.
void_if: a pathway's published figure is revised and the register is not
constructions.licenses: That the enumerated set is unclosed, and floors on sums over it.
constructions.not_licensed: Any percentage of a total the register cannot close.

constructions.title: How the national nutrient and oxygen figures are produced - the fields LANDBRUG.md prints

diffuse_load.area_measured_pct.is: The share of Danish land area whose nitrogen transport is measured at stream stations, as the monitoring documentation states it.

diffuse_load.area_modelled_pct.is: The share whose transport is modelled instead.

diffuse_load.retention_uncertainty_natio.is: The stated uncertainty of the national average retention, in percentage points.

load_trend_vs_outcome.nitrogen_load.appr.is: The flow-normalised nitrogen supply from Danish land to the sea around the start of the series, kilotonnes a year, as reported by DCE and summarised at miljotilstand.dk - an approximate reading of the published series.
The same supply in recent years, on the same terms.

load_trend_vs_outcome.nitrogen_load.redu.is: The reduction between the two, as a percentage, on the same terms.

load_trend_vs_outcome.iltsvind_extent.ob.is: The year of one observation of the area affected by oxygen depletion.
The area of Danish inner waters affected by oxygen depletion in September of that year, square kilometres, from DCE's notices.
The same, for a late-September notice.

typetal_nutrients_mg_per_l.combined_over.is: The standard concentration of total nitrogen assumed for combined-sewer overflow water, mg per litre.
The standard chemical oxygen demand assumed for the same water, mg per litre.

constructions.what: A hand-curated register of documented properties of the Danish measurement system, each with its source; this declaration covers the diffuse-load, load-trend and standard-concentration fields the Danish-language page prints.
constructions.model: Values are transcribed from the named technical annexes and reports; where an entry is the project's reading rather than the source's words, the register marks it inferred.

justified.text: The register's own rule: nothing is inferred without being marked, and each entry carries its source.

gaps: The figures are transcribed, not read from pinned texts, so a change in a source is not detected.
Several load figures are stated as approximate in the register's own field names.
void_if: a source is revised and the register is not
constructions.not_licensed: That the stated properties are the whole account of the measurement system.

constructions.title: Counts and constants the Danish-language page derives itself

n_unquantified.is: Of those, the pathways with no lower bound: the empty rows.

agri_pct.is: The published agricultural share of the Danish land-based waterborne nitrogen load, as this page quotes it; the page's subject is what that share is a share of.

c_per_n.is: Carbon per nitrogen by mass at the Redfield ratio, from the molar ratio and the atomic masses in the generator.

c_per_cod.is: Carbon per unit of chemical oxygen demand by mass: one oxygen molecule oxidises one carbon atom.

constructions.what: Writes the few numbers the page derives itself - two counts over the pathway register, the published agricultural share it quotes, and two stoichiometric constants - so that the page reads them back live.
constructions.model: The counts are taken over the pathway register as it stands at the build; the constants are `(106 * 12.011) / (16 * 14.007)` and `12 / 32` in the code's terms.
assumptions: The Redfield ratio applies to the organic matter a nitrogen load could produce.

justified.text: The counts are recomputed from the register at every build, so a filled row changes the page.

gaps: The agricultural share is typed into the generator; it is not pinned to the document that publishes it.
The Redfield ratio is an ocean average, not a measured ratio for Danish overflow water.
constructions.licenses: The counts and the arithmetic the page does with them.
constructions.not_licensed: That the published share is right.
